  1) y/p       = 0.400299424685491941412237920136078078570936627989436474355800763988659548296974472020233503111073944903824898805087210896741933336645418894770599594098401853

  3) (x.(y/p))/p = C = 0.079546336499460462554501802883040753799770017855946243657403747988737825607683251435419657170337565794313101022542094127614728505372509254656081463062214006

COUNT METRIC
  n = number of incremental steps (matrix row / EC add).
  At step n form:
      n.(C) / p
  where C = (x_135.(y_135/p))/p
  That is exactly:  n.(x_135.(y_135/p))/p  with the inner mix already reduced once.

INTERPRETATION A  (nested reduce then count):
  C = (x.(y/p))/p
  target(n) = (n.C)/p

INTERPRETATION B  (single final /p):
  M = n.(x.(y/p))   # integer n, then digits of x.(y/p) ?
  Better B1: M = n + (x.(y/p))/10^{digits(x)+?} — ambiguous.
  Practical B: M = n.(digits of x.(y/p) fractional? No.)
  Use B as: M = n . <156 digits of (x.(y/p))/1 truncated via x.(y/p) value's frac>
            target = M/p

CALIBRATION: how many incremental lead steps exist in solved matrix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  plateau lead steps recorded = 49
  That is the known-matrix 'how many times' on solved keys only.
  For P135 search: n is the step counter of the incremental walk;
  stop when the live point's nested print matches the fixed P135 C-target
  under the chosen interpretation (A recommended: stable C from pubkey).

FIXED FINGERPRINT C (independent of n)
  C = (x_135.(y_135/p))/p
  C = 0.079546336499460462554501802883040753799770017855946243657403747988737825607683251435419657170337565794313101022542094127614728505372509254656081463062214006

or until a walk's state hits a predicate involving that form.
